results.author: Guru Ram Das Ji (M4)
results.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਇਆ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਮੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਸਮ ਲਗਾਵੈਗੋ ॥੮॥੩॥
results.translit: naanak daiaa daiaa kar thaakur mai satigur bhasam lagaavaigo
results.en: Nanak prays: please show kindness and compassion to me, O my Lord and Master, that I may apply the dust of the True Guru to my forehead. ||8||3||

results.author: Guru Ram Das Ji (M4)
results.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਇਆ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਦੀਨੀ ਦੁਖੁ ਦਾਲਦੁ ਭੰਜਿ ਸਮਾਵੈਗੋ ॥੮॥੫॥
results.translit: naanak daiaa daiaa kar deenee dukh daalad bhanj samaavaigo
results.en: O Nanak, God has been kind and compassionate; He has blessed me. Removing pain and poverty, He has blended me with Himself. ||8||5||

results.author: Guru Ram Das Ji (M4)
results.gurmukhi: ਦਇਆ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਹਮ ਦੀਨ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਾਇ ॥
results.translit: daiaa daiaa kar raakhah har jeeu ham deen teree saranaai
results.en: Have mercy, have mercy, please save me, Dear Lord. I am meek and humble - I seek Your protection.

results.author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji (M5)
results.en: The Creator has showered His Kindness;

results.author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji (M5)
results.en: The Life of the World, the Sustainer of the Earth, has showered His Mercy;
